specification_metadata.title: ISL Multi-Signer Development Split Specification
specification_metadata.phase: Phase 34B — Dataset Quality Audit, Leakage Forensics, and Signer-Level Split Freeze
specification_metadata.governance_note: This specification is strictly PROVISIONAL and cannot be frozen or approved until physical collection, quality auditing, and manifest reconciliation for signer_06 through signer_11 are completed.

legacy_inclusion_conditions.signer_01: Permitted for training pool only; strictly prohibited from within-signer validation claims due to historical adjacent-frame leakage.
legacy_inclusion_conditions.signer_04_train: Approved 26 recordings (Letters A-M Condition 1, Letters N-Z Condition 2; 810 frames) with zero recording overlap with signer_04_val.

legacy_inclusion_conditions.signer_04_val: Approved 26 recordings (Letters A-M Condition 2, Letters N-Z Condition 1; 811 frames) with zero recording overlap with signer_04_train.

external_holdout.governance_contract: Permanently sealed and excluded from training, feature engineering, normalization tuning, hyperparameter search, and model selection. Accessible only for final zero-shot generalization evaluation.

frozen_benchmark.governance_contract: Fixed external benchmark. Permanently excluded from training and tuning under the historical governance protocol.

freeze_prerequisites: 1. Complete collection of planned 234 takes for each of signer_06 through signer_11 (total 1,404 takes).
2. 100% manifest-to-disk reconciliation (zero missing frame files, zero orphaned media).
3. Quality gate compliance: zero blur failures (<50), brightness in [40, 220], zero unaddressed duplicate hashes.
4. Split isolation verification: 0 sample overlap, 0 recording overlap, 0 session overlap between dev_train and dev_val.
5. Cryptographic manifest hashing: Compute and record immutable SHA-256 checksums for dev_train_manifest.json and dev_val_manifest.json.

fail_closed_governance_rules.unknown_signer_handling: REJECT with ValueError if signer_id is not in permitted role mapping.
fail_closed_governance_rules.unauthorized_training_attempt: REJECT with ValueError if any sample has allow_training=False or originates from signer_05, signer_10, signer_11, signer_02, or signer_03.
fail_closed_governance_rules.missing_metadata_handling: REJECT with ValueError if required schema fields (signer_id, letter, condition, source) are absent or null.
fail_closed_governance_rules.tampered_manifest_handling: REJECT if SHA-256 manifest hash does not match frozen registry.
